GameplayBaseBuildingData.description: GameplayBaseBuildingData separates checks performed while placing an object hologram from checks performed when the construction action is completed.

ConstructionData.description: ConstructionData controls checks and item handling during construction, after the placement preview has been accepted.

HologramData.description: HologramData controls preview-time placement checks. These checks decide whether the hologram is considered a valid placement before construction.

GameplayConstructionData.description: GameplayConstructionData controls validation and item handling while a player completes base construction.

disableDistanceCheck.description: DisableDistanceCheck bypasses the normal distance restriction applied to the player during construction.

disableDropAttachmentsOnFall.description: DisableDropAttachmentsOnFall keeps attached items on a construction object when it falls.

disableIsCollidingCheck.description: DisableIsCollidingCheck permits construction when the object collides with objects in the world.

disableItemFalling.description: DisableItemFalling prevents construction items dropped during the construction process from falling.

disablePerformRoofCheck.description: DisablePerformRoofCheck permits construction that clips through a roof.

disableRefundMaterialsOnFall.description: DisableRefundMaterialsOnFall prevents construction materials from being refunded when the construction object falls.

GameplayDrowningData.description: GameplayDrowningData sets how quickly player resources are depleted while drowning.

healthDepletionSpeed.description: HealthDepletionSpeed sets health lost per second while drowning.

shockDepletionSpeed.description: ShockDepletionSpeed sets shock lost per second while drowning.

staminaDepletionSpeed.description: StaminaDepletionSpeed sets stamina points lost per second while drowning.

GameplayExternalLockData.description: GameplayExternalLockData controls temporary lockouts after failed attempts to open an external lock.

protectionCountStageOne.description: ProtectionCountStageOne sets the number of failed attempts before the first protection stage is applied.

protectionCountStageTwo.description: ProtectionCountStageTwo sets the number of failed attempts before the second protection stage is applied.

protectionResetTime.description: ProtectionResetTime sets how long the failed-attempt counter remains active before it is reset, in seconds.

protectionTime.description: ProtectionTime sets the duration of the protection lockout in seconds.

GameplayFile.description: GameplayFile is the root of `cfggameplay.json`, the mission-level file for server-side gameplay rules.

BaseBuildingData.description:
BaseBuildingData controls checks applied when previewing and constructing base-building objects.
Disabling a check permits placements that thecorresponding rule would otherwise reject.

ExternalLockData.description: ExternalLockData configures lockout thresholds and timers that slow repeated failed attempts to open an external lock.

GeneralData.description: GeneralData controls general rules such as damage to base structures and containers, and the availability of respawn actions.

MapData.description: MapData controls whether map and navigation features require their corresponding inventory items and which navigation details are shown.

PlayerData.description: PlayerData controls player-side rules, including stamina, movement, shock recovery, drowning, weapon obstruction, and spawn gear presets.

SandstormData.description: SandstormData scales how frequently sandstorms occur in worlds that use the sandstorm system.

UIData.description: UIData controls gameplay-related interface behavior, including the directional hit indicator and map presentation.

VehicleData.description: VehicleData controls vehicle behavior such as boat decay and whether attached car or bike wheels can detach or take damage.

WorldsData.description: WorldsData controls world-level settings such as night lighting, temperature and wetness effects, object spawners, and restricted areas.

version.description:
Version is the game's internal version marker for this configuration format.
It is maintained by the game and is not a gameplay setting.

GameplayGeneralData.description: GameplayGeneralData controls mission-wide damage and respawn behavior.

disableBaseDamage.description: DisableBaseDamage prevents damage to structures built through the base-building system, such as fences and watchtowers.

disableContainerDamage.description:
DisableContainerDamage prevents damage to storage containers such as tents and barrels.
It is separate from damage to base-building structures.

disableRespawnDialog.description: DisableRespawnDialog removes the dialog that lets a player choose a respawn type after requesting respawn.

disableRespawnInUnconsciousness.description: DisableRespawnInUnconsciousness hides the pause-menu Respawn action while the player is unconscious, preventing respawn from that state.

GameplayHitIndicationData.description: GameplayHitIndicationData controls the directional damage indicator.

hitDirectionBehaviour.description:
HitDirectionBehaviour selects indicator motion:
  - 0 disables it,
  - 1 keeps it static,
  - 2 uses the moving dynamic behavior.

hitDirectionBreakPointRelative.description:
HitDirectionBreakPointRelative is the fraction of the actual display duration after which the indicator starts fading.
0 fades immediately; 1 leaves no time for fading.

hitDirectionIndicatorColorStr.description: HitDirectionIndicatorColorStr sets the indicator color as a hexadecimal ARGB string, for example `0xFFBB0A1E`.

hitDirectionMaxDuration.description:
HitDirectionMaxDuration sets the upper bound for how long the indicator is displayed.
Actual duration varies with hit severity and is between 60% and 100% of this value.

hitDirectionOverrideEnabled.description:
HitDirectionOverrideEnabled tells the game to use the values in this section.
Unspecified fields are treated as zero when the section is used.

hitDirectionScatter.description: HitDirectionScatter is the maximum random angular offset applied to the indicated hit direction. The offset is randomized in both directions.

hitDirectionStyle.description: HitDirectionStyle selects the indicator graphic: 0 splash, 1 spike, or 2 arrow.

hitIndicationPostProcessEnabled.description: HitIndicationPostProcessEnabled controls the legacy red-flash postprocess effect that appears when the player is hit.

GameplayHologramData.description: GameplayHologramData controls validation performed while positioning a base-building hologram.

disableColdAreaBuildingCheck.description:
DisableColdAreaBuildingCheck is the legacy spelling found in some official mission files.
The current gameplay script uses DisableColdAreaPlacementCheck for this rule.

disableColdAreaPlacementCheck.description:
DisableColdAreaPlacementCheck permits garden-plot placement on frozen ground.
This is the key exposed by the current gameplay script.

disableHeightPlacementCheck.description: DisableHeightPlacementCheck permits placement when there is not enough vertical clearance for the object.

disableIsBaseViableCheck.description: DisableIsBaseViableCheck permits placement on dynamic objects or other surfaces that the game would otherwise reject as unsuitable.

disableIsClippingRoofCheck.description: DisableIsClippingRoofCheck permits placement that would clip through a roof.

disableIsCollidingAngleCheck.description: DisableIsCollidingAngleCheck permits placement even when its roll, pitch, or yaw exceeds the normal angle limits.

disableIsCollidingBBoxCheck.description: DisableIsCollidingBBoxCheck permits placement when the hologram's bounding box overlaps objects in the world.

disableIsCollidingGPlotCheck.description: DisableIsCollidingGPlotCheck permits garden plots on surface types that are normally incompatible.

disableIsCollidingPlayerCheck.description: DisableIsCollidingPlayerCheck permits placement when the hologram overlaps a player.

disableIsInTerrainCheck.description: DisableIsInTerrainCheck permits placement when the object intersects the terrain.

disableIsPlacementPermittedCheck.description: DisableIsPlacementPermittedCheck bypasses the general permission check that can reject a placement after the basic placement checks.

disableIsUnderwaterCheck.description: DisableIsUnderwaterCheck permits placement below the water surface.

disallowedTypesInUnderground.description:
DisallowedTypesInUnderground lists item types that cannot be placed in underground areas.
The restriction also applies to inherited types.

GameplayMapData.description: GameplayMapData controls map access and the navigation information shown on the map interface.

displayNavInfo.description: DisplayNavInfo controls whether compass and GPS information appears in the map legend, including when the player carries those items.

displayPlayerPosition.description: DisplayPlayerPosition shows the player's red position marker and heading on the map.

ignoreMapOwnership.description: IgnoreMapOwnership allows the player to open the map without carrying a map item.

ignoreNavItemsOwnership.description: IgnoreNavItemsOwnership allows map navigation helpers without requiring a compass or GPS receiver.

GameplayMovementData.description: GameplayMovementData controls how quickly jogging and sprinting movement transitions blend and how quickly the character can rotate.

allowStaminaAffectInertia.description: AllowStaminaAffectInertia lets the character's current stamina affect movement inertia.

rotationSpeedJog.description: RotationSpeedJog sets the character's rotation speed while jogging.

rotationSpeedSprint.description: RotationSpeedSprint sets the character's rotation speed while sprinting.

timeToSprint.description: TimeToSprint sets the transition time from jogging to sprinting.

timeToStrafeJog.description: TimeToStrafeJog sets the blend time for diagonal movement while jogging.

timeToStrafeSprint.description: TimeToStrafeSprint sets the blend time for diagonal movement while sprinting.

GameplayPlayerData.description: GameplayPlayerData groups rules that affect a player's controls, movement, survival, and initial equipment.

DrowningData.description: DrowningData sets the per-second stamina, health, and shock loss while a character is drowning.

MovementData.description: MovementData sets transition times and turning rates for jogging and sprinting, and whether stamina affects movement inertia.

ShockHandlingData.description: ShockHandlingData sets how quickly shock recovers while conscious or unconscious and whether ammunition can modify that recovery.

StaminaData.description: StaminaData sets the stamina pool and the rates at which common actions consume it, including sprinting, swimming, and climbing.

WeaponObstructionData.description: WeaponObstructionData selects how the game handles a weapon blocked by static scenery or by dynamic objects.

disablePersonalLight.description: DisablePersonalLight turns off the local light that normally illuminates nearby objects around a player at night.

spawnGearPresetFiles.description:
SpawnGearPresetFiles lists mission-relative JSON files that define server spawn gear presets.
Files may be in subdirectories; when the list is non-empty,
these presets control character equipment at spawn and replace the usual StartingEquipSetup behavior.

GameplaySandstormData.description: GameplaySandstormData controls the occurrence rate of sandstorms.

sandstormFrequency.description:
SandstormFrequency sets how often sandstorms occur:
 - 0 disables them,
 - 1 uses the normal rate,
 - 2 makes them occur twice as often.

GameplayShockHandlingData.description: GameplayShockHandlingData controls how quickly the player's shock value recovers in each consciousness state.

allowRefillSpeedModifier.description: AllowRefillSpeedModifier allows ammunition settings to modify shock recovery speed, which can change how quickly a shot player wakes up.

shockRefillSpeedConscious.description: ShockRefillSpeedConscious sets shock recovery per second while the player is conscious.

shockRefillSpeedUnconscious.description: ShockRefillSpeedUnconscious sets shock recovery per second while the player is unconscious.

GameplayStaminaData.description: GameplayStaminaData controls the stamina pool and action-specific stamina costs.

holdBreathStaminaModifier.description: HoldBreathStaminaModifier scales stamina consumption while holding breath.

meleeStaminaModifier.description: MeleeStaminaModifier scales stamina consumption for heavy melee attacks and evasive moves.

obstacleTraversalStaminaModifier.description: ObstacleTraversalStaminaModifier scales stamina consumption when jumping, climbing, or vaulting over obstacles.

sprintLadderStaminaModifier.description: SprintLadderStaminaModifier scales stamina consumption while climbing a ladder quickly.

sprintStaminaModifierCro.description: SprintStaminaModifierCro scales stamina consumption while sprinting crouched.

sprintStaminaModifierErc.description: SprintStaminaModifierErc scales stamina consumption while sprinting upright.

sprintSwimmingStaminaModifier.description: SprintSwimmingStaminaModifier scales stamina consumption during fast swimming.

staminaKgToStaminaPercentPenalty.description: StaminaKgToStaminaPercentPenalty scales the reduction of maximum stamina calculated from the character's carried load.

staminaMax.description: StaminaMax sets the maximum stamina pool. Setting it to zero may produce unexpected results.

staminaMinCap.description: StaminaMinCap sets the minimum size of the stamina cap. Setting it to zero may produce unexpected results.

staminaWeightLimitThreshold.description: StaminaWeightLimitThreshold is the amount of stamina points, divided by 1000, excluded from the load-based reduction of maximum stamina.

GameplayUIData.description: GameplayUIData controls interface features that affect gameplay feedback or navigation.

HitIndicationData.description: HitIndicationData configures the direction marker shown when the player takes damage, including its appearance and timing.

use3DMap.description: Use3DMap enables the 3D map and disables the default 2D map overlay.

GameplayVehicleData.description: GameplayVehicleData controls vehicle decay and wheel behavior.

boatDecayMultiplier.description:
BoatDecayMultiplier scales how quickly boats decay.
A larger multiplier makes decay faster; 1 leaves the normal rate unchanged.

canDamageAttachedBikeWheels.description: CanDamageAttachedBikeWheels allows damage to reduce the condition of wheels attached to motorcycles.

canDamageAttachedCarWheels.description: CanDamageAttachedCarWheels allows damage to reduce the condition of wheels attached to cars.

canDetachAttachedBikeWheels.description: CanDetachAttachedBikeWheels allows attached motorcycle wheels to detach.

canDetachAttachedCarWheels.description: CanDetachAttachedCarWheels allows attached car wheels to detach.

GameplayWeaponObstructionData.description: GameplayWeaponObstructionData selects the response when an obstacle blocks a weapon.

dynamicMode.description:
DynamicMode selects obstruction handling for dynamic objects:
 - 0 does not obstruct but still lifts the weapon,
 - 1 obstructs before lifting it,
 - 2 always obstructs without lifting.

staticMode.description:
StaticMode selects obstruction handling for static objects:
 - 0 does not obstruct but still lifts the weapon,
 - 1 obstructs before lifting it,
 - 2 always obstructs without lifting.

GameplayWorldsData.description: GameplayWorldsData controls environment behavior and additional world configuration files loaded by the mission.

bunkerBroadcastEnabled.description: BunkerBroadcastEnabled controls Morse-code broadcasts associated with discovering the bunker.

environmentMaxTemps.description:
EnvironmentMaxTemps sets the maximum ambient temperature for each month, ordered January through December.
The game expects exactly 12 values.

environmentMinTemps.description:
EnvironmentMinTemps sets the minimum ambient temperature for each month, ordered January through December.
The game expects exactly 12 values.

lightingConfig.description: LightingConfig selects the night lighting preset: 0 is brighter and 1 is darker. World-specific settings may define additional values.

objectSpawnersArr.description: ObjectSpawnersArr lists mission-relative JSON files containing object spawner data. An empty or omitted list loads no custom spawner files.

playerRestrictedAreaFiles.description:
PlayerRestrictedAreaFiles lists mission-relative JSON files that define areas with player restrictions.
A non-empty list enables loading them.

wetnessWeightModifiers.description: WetnessWeightModifiers scales item weight at the five wetness levels, in order: dry, damp, wet, soaked, and drenched.
